The\ncontrol plane is any server that implements the\n",["$","$La",null,{"href":"/reference/node-protocol","data-v":true,"children":"node protocol","data-v-link":true,"to":"/reference/node-protocol"}],"."]}],"\n",["$","img",null,{"src":"$b","alt":"The node protocol as a sequence between a roxy node and its control plane. Once, the node enrols with its enrolment token and gets a node token back, which it keeps in its state dir with its CA and any quarantine marker. Every refresh_after_seconds it asks for its lease, reporting its state and the lease it holds, and gets back the lease: the config, the secrets and how long it is valid; with no lease before the old one expires, the node denies everything. Every few seconds it sends a batch of flow-log events and gets back an acknowledgement up to a sequence number. 11:["$","p",null,{"data-v":"","children":["The state dir holds the node token, a flow sequence counter, the CA in\n",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"ca/"}],", and a ",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"quarantine"}]," file while the node is quarantined. 13:["$","p",null,{"data-v":"","children":["The CA always lives in ",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"<state-dir>/ca"}],". On first start roxy generates\none, or imports the pair given with ",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"--interception-ca-cert"}]," and\n",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"--interception-ca-key"}],". After that the stored CA is used. If the flags\nname a different pair, roxy refuses to start, since workloads already\ntrust the stored CA. 16:["$","ol",null,{"data-v":"","children":["\n",["$","li",null,{"data-v":"","children":["The listeners open at once with an empty policy, so every request is\ndenied and ",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"/readyz"}]," answers ",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"503 no_policy"}],"."]}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"data-v":"","children":"Without a stored node token, the node enrols with the enrolment token.\nIf the control plane refuses it, the node retries for two minutes and\nthen exits, so an orchestrator sees a crash loop. An unreachable\ncontrol plane is retried for as long as it takes."}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"data-v":"","children":["The node fetches its lease and applies it. Settings that only apply at\nstartup (",["$","$La",null,{"href":"/guides/operations#restart-only-settings","data-v":true,"children":"restart-only settings","data-v-link":true,"to":"/guides/operations#restart-only-settings"}],")\nare taken from the first lease. A later lease that changes one is\nlogged and needs a restart."]}],"\n"]}]
17:["$","h2",null,{"data-v":"","id":"the-lease","children":["The lease",["$","$La",null,{"aria-label":"Copy link and go to this section","className":"heading-anchor","title":"Copy link and go to this section","href":"/guides/node-mode#the-lease","children":["$","svg",null,{"className":"heading-anchor-icon","xmlns":"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","width":"0.75em","height":"0.75em","viewBox":"0 0 24 24","fill":"none","stroke":"currentColor","strokeWidth":"2","strokeLinecap":"round","strokeLinejoin":"round","children":[["$","path",null,{"d":"M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"}],["$","path",null,{"d":"M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"}]]}],"data-v-link":true,"data-v":true,"to":"/guides/node-mode#the-lease"}]]}]
18:["$","p",null,{"data-v":"","children":["Every lease is the whole policy, applied in full or not at all. A lease\nthat ",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"roxy check"}]," would reject, or that lacks a secret the config needs, is\nlogged and the running policy stays."]}]
19:["$","p",null,{"data-v":"","children":["The lease sets the policy's expiry (",["$","$La",null,{"href":"/guides/operations#lease","data-v":true,"children":"lease","data-v-link":true,"to":"/guides/operations#lease"}],"),\nmeasured on the node's own clock. The node polls again before it runs\nout. If the control plane is unreachable, the lease expires and roxy\ndenies everything until the next successful poll, with no restart needed."]}]
1a:["$","p",null,{"data-v":"","children":["A revoked node (",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"410"}],") denies everything at once and stops polling. A\nnode never enrols again on its own. To re-enrol it, empty the state dir\nand start it with a new enrolment token."]}]
1b:["$","p",null,{"data-v":"","children":["A ",["$","$La",null,{"href":"/guides/operations#quarantine","data-v":true,"children":"quarantined","data-v-link":true,"to":"/guides/operations#quarantine"}]," node keeps applying\nleases. It reports the quarantine on every poll, and lifts it when the\ncontrol plane releases that incident in a lease."]}]
1c:["$","p",null,{"data-v":"","children":"The node renews its token before it expires. If the token does expire,\nthe node exits, since only re-enrolment can recover it."}]

1e:["$","p",null,{"data-v":"","children":["Every flow-log event goes to the local flow log as usual, and to the\ncontrol plane in batches, as the lease's ",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"flow"}]," settings say\n(",["$","$La",null,{"href":"/reference/node-protocol#flow-upload","data-v":true,"children":"flow upload","data-v-link":true,"to":"/reference/node-protocol#flow-upload"}],"). Events wait in\nmemory until the control plane acknowledges them. When too many are\nwaiting, the lease decides whether roxy holds traffic (",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"hold"}],") or drops the\noldest events (",["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"spool"}],"). On shutdown roxy ships what is waiting, for up to\nten seconds."]}]
1f:["$","p",null,{"data-v":"","children":[["$","code",null,{"data-v":true,"children":"SIGHUP"}]," reopens the local log files.
